core_alignment: The presentation and PR3 ask whether a learned trigger adds useful warning and QoS benefit while keeping rerouting otherwise identical. The completed four-policy benchmark directly addresses that question.

explicit_scope_changes.original: Presentation starts at 500 ms/two samples; PR3 promises 500/250/100 ms comparisons including burst visibility/counter freshness
explicit_scope_changes.actual: Nine native steady-load interval trials used an older collector; current collector runs at 250 ms with actual-time windows and disclosed resolution limits
explicit_scope_changes.disposition: Preserve the one-second duration in seconds; current full-collector burst-resolution/interval ablation is not established

explicit_scope_changes.original: Shared cooldown/recovery and ongoing reactive/proactive rerouting
explicit_scope_changes.actual: A shared cooldown/action guard exists, but each trial permits one alternate switch followed by cleanup
explicit_scope_changes.disposition: Repeated recovery, switch-back and oscillation behavior are not evaluated

explicit_scope_changes.original: Earlier text uses end-to-end delay and PR3 calls for effective rule-installation delay
explicit_scope_changes.actual: Mean/median/p95 received-probe RTT is now fully derived; CLI command/readback time is measured
explicit_scope_changes.disposition: Do not claim one-way delay, packet-level activation or disruption measurements

explicit_scope_changes.original: PR3 promises at least three repetitions and more if variation is high
explicit_scope_changes.actual: Three different matched seeds per policy/scenario; reactive burst loss varies 0.606%–15.030%; no expanded repetitions completed
explicit_scope_changes.disposition: Explain admission-denial mechanisms and qualify generalization; additional repetitions remain needed for a stronger stability claim

explicit_scope_changes.original: PR3 initial 50-packet queues and original shaping
explicit_scope_changes.actual: Recorded dual calibration uses source queue 250, bottleneck queues 50 and cburst 16 KiB, identically across all final policies

explicit_scope_changes.original: Integrate ML with SDN routing/controller logic
explicit_scope_changes.actual: OS-Ken establishes baseline rules; a shared external Python decision/action loop drives OpenFlow CLI updates
explicit_scope_changes.disposition: Describe this control-plane prototype accurately; no native in-controller ML module or production deployment is claimed
